tours.name: Give a User Employees Access
tours.description: Learn how to give a user officer access to the Employees app by adding the right group to their record.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to give a user officer access to the Employees app by adding the right group to their record.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.description: Users, groups and access rules are managed in the Settings app. Only administrators can open it.

description_i18n.en_US: Users, groups and access rules are managed in the Settings app. Only administrators can open it.

steps.title: Users & Companies
steps.description: This menu holds the users who can sign in, the groups that give them rights, and the companies they can work in.

description_i18n.en_US: This menu holds the users who can sign in, the groups that give them rights, and the companies they can work in.

steps.title: Users
steps.description: Every person who can sign in to Odoo is listed here. Open a user to see or change what that person is allowed to do.

description_i18n.en_US: Every person who can sign in to Odoo is listed here. Open a user to see or change what that person is allowed to do.

steps.title: Find the user
steps.content: Type the user's name and press Enter.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the user's name and press Enter.

steps.description: Search first so you open the right person. You can type part of the name or the login.

description_i18n.en_US: Search first so you open the right person. You can type part of the name or the login.

steps.title: Open the user
steps.content: Click the user to open the record.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the user to open the record.

steps.description: The user form shows the sign-in details and the Access Rights tab.

description_i18n.en_US: The user form shows the sign-in details and the Access Rights tab.

steps.title: Add a line
steps.content: Click Add a line to give the user another group.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Add a line to give the user another group.

steps.description: Each line is a group the user belongs to. A group opens menus and allows actions. Employees officers can create and edit every employee.

description_i18n.en_US: Each line is a group the user belongs to. A group opens menus and allows actions. Employees officers can create and edit every employee.

steps.title: Find the group
steps.content: Type "Manage all employees" and press Enter.

content_i18n.en_US: Type "Manage all employees" and press Enter.

steps.description: The list is long, so search for the group. The name of the Employees group that gives officer access contains these words.

description_i18n.en_US: The list is long, so search for the group. The name of the Employees group that gives officer access contains these words.

steps.title: Select the group
steps.content: Tick the group in the list.

content_i18n.en_US: Tick the group in the list.

steps.description: Only tick the group that matches the job of this person. Higher groups include the rights of the lower ones.

description_i18n.en_US: Only tick the group that matches the job of this person. Higher groups include the rights of the lower ones.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.description: The group is added to the user's lines but is not stored yet.

description_i18n.en_US: The group is added to the user's lines but is not stored yet.

steps.title: Save
steps.content: Click the save icon to keep the change.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the save icon to keep the change.

steps.description: The rights apply as soon as you save. The user may need to reload the page to see the new menus.

description_i18n.en_US: The rights apply as soon as you save. The user may need to reload the page to see the new menus.
